Whether it be for illness or injury, the preferred healing method in Moon Flower Kingdom has always been the country’s special medicinal baths. However, after his party is attacked by a mysterious figure during a regional inspection, Prince Keiun witnesses a never-before-seen lifesaving medical technique. Just who is this girl, and who is after the prince’s life? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Eight billion humans were sacrificed, and only a handful were allowed to survive—to be toyed with endlessly as the evil god’s playthings. The “Frashokereti” (Renewal of the World), which had been repeated countless times since the dawn of the universe, was shattered here for the first time. The sun will never rise again. In a world where reason has gone mad, there is only one thing of value: human blood. Blood is currency. Blood is fuel. Blood is—a weapon. After countless sacrifices, the magicians devised a single spell. A forbidden ritual that transforms a girl’s blood into a blade capable of vanquishing demons. Blood as a weapon. Life as a weapon.
